city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: Hanahan: 12.6% of residents were 65 or older (2020 census); elevation 16 ft; several neighborhoods have tidal water behind them with access to the Cooper River and Charleston Harbor; Goose Creek Reservoir sits in the middle of the city.

neighborhoods.value: Tanner Plantation (primarily residential portion of the city); Otranto Plantation (NRHP 1978).

place_entities.value: Hanahan Recreation Complex; Goose Creek Reservoir; Hanahan Amphitheater (opened 2013); Yeamans Hall Club (1925, private golf); City Hall, 1255 Yeamans Hall Road.
place_entities.source: https://www.cityofhanahan.com/ (City of Hanahan, recreation complex); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hanahan,_South_Carolina (Wikipedia: reservoir, amphitheater, Yeamans Hall) (read 2026-10-14)
